title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
prompt: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring without repeating characters. A substring must use contiguous characters.
constraints: The input may contain spaces and ordinary Unicode Java chars.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring Length
prompt: Return the length of the longest palindromic substring in s.

title: Decode Ways
prompt: Return the number of valid decodings for a digit string where 1 through 26 map to letters.
constraints: A zero is valid only as part of 10 or 20.

title: First Unique Character
prompt: Return the index of the first character that appears once, or -1 when every character repeats.
constraints: The input contains lowercase English letters.

title: Longest Valid Parentheses
prompt: Return the length of the longest valid parentheses substring.

title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid
prompt: Return the minimum additions needed to make the parentheses string valid.

title: Count Palindromic Substrings
prompt: Return the number of contiguous palindromic substrings.

title: Longest Consecutive Run
prompt: The input is a comma-separated integer list. Return the longest consecutive-value run.
constraints: The input contains at least one integer.
Values may be repeated and may be negative.

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
prompt: The input is encoded as s|k. Return the longest uniform window after at most k replacements.
constraints: The string part contains uppercase English letters.

title: Maximum Depth of a Binary Tree
prompt: Given a comma-separated level-order encoding of a binary tree, return its maximum depth. Null child positions are written as null.
constraints: The encoding uses integer values and null tokens separated by commas.
An empty tree is represented by null.

title: Count Islands in a Grid
prompt: Rows are separated by slash characters and contain 1 for land or 0 for water. Return the number of four-directionally connected islands.
constraints: Only horizontal and vertical neighbors connect.

title: Count Balanced Parentheses Sequences
prompt: Return how many balanced parenthesis strings can be formed with n pairs. The input is n as a decimal string.
constraints: A prefix may never contain more closing than opening parentheses.

title: Minimum Coin Change
prompt: The input is encoded as denominations separated by commas, followed by | and a target amount. Return the fewest coins needed, or -1 when the target is impossible.
constraints: Each denomination can be used any number of times.
